requestedOutcome: Protect public knowledge APIs with a seeded administrator login and secure browser sessions.
goal: Deliver a fail-closed, single-administrator password login that protects every knowledge-library API and supports public HTTPS deployment.
successEvidence: Fresh DB bootstrap, protected-route, CSRF, logout/password-rotation, frontend login, and deployment configuration evidence all pass.
stopCondition: Done only after all authenticated flows and regressions pass; blocked if a required security boundary cannot be verified.
nonGoals: Registration, SSO, MFA, password reset, multi-user tenancy.
scope: Backend auth persistence/API enforcement, frontend login/session UX, migration, environment and deployment documentation.
riskHints: Passwords, bearer-session handling, public API access and migration contracts are security-sensitive.
